issue.title: Bug: README.md suggests Ubuntu 20.04 for building SONiC but 20.04 is EOL

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

In README.md, we see the following text when explaining build requirements:

```
A good choice of OS for building SONiC is currently Ubuntu 20.04.
```

However, Ubuntu 20.04 has gone EOL 31 May 2025. Release lifecycle information here: https://ubuntu.com/about/release-cycle 22.04 and 24.04 have been out for 3 and 1 years respectively, so it is likely that one of these two would be a better option to recommend.

It looks like the CI infrastructure runs on 22.04 now:
#22676

Please update the README to recommend a newer Ubuntu release.

### Steps to Reproduce

Read README.md.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Ubuntu 20.04 is recommended, but it should be a newer release recommended.

resolution.title: Update recommended OS version for building SONiC
resolution.description:
Ubuntu 20.04 has gone EOL. Ubuntu 22.04 is in standard support until April 2027. 22.04 is also the version used in the `sonic-buildimage` repo's Azure Pipelines builds

Fixes #22704

#### Why I did it

Ubuntu 20.04 is EOL so shouldn't be recommended.
